author: architecture-conformance-auditor
scope: Adversarial gate before code is written against batch A (8 open issues: 256, 258, 259, 260, 261, 262, 263, 264).

evidence_labels.MEASURED: Checked against disk, git or the live GitHub API by this pass, now.
evidence_labels.CITED: Read from an artifact; not independently re-derived by this pass.
evidence_labels.INFERRED: Derived by reasoning over MEASURED or CITED inputs; the derivation is stated.

verdict.note: 4 of 8 have an empty blocked_by. Of those 4, V2-004's stated starting condition is false on disk. So 3 of 8 can start today against a correct premise.

blockers.title: The audit file that exists satisfies none of V2-004's three acceptance criteria
blockers.what_is_missing: AC1 requires 'exactly 46 policy rows'. MEASURED: the file has 9 table blocks; the policy enumerations are four separate tables of 18 / 11 / 8 / 8 rows plus one STALE-TOPOLOGY policy named in prose, not one 46-row matrix. AC2 requires every row to carry a non-empty Evidence cell citing file:line or an explicit NONE. MEASURED: only the 18-row ENFORCED table has an 'Enforcement point' column; the PARTIAL (11), CONTRADICTED (8) and DOCUMENTED-ONLY (8) tables are 2-column and carry no evidence cell. AC3 requires the header to state the read pass covered the policy corpus line-by-line. MEASURED: the file's header states the opposite -- 'Scope of this pass: consolidation plus spot-verification, NOT re-analysis' -- and its section 8 states '41 of the 46 individual classifications were not re-verified'. Separately MEASURED: the string 'Post-plugin' occurs 0 times in the file, and no table exceeds 4 columns, so V2-005's 7-column requirement is also unmet.
blockers.risk_if_unaddressed: Two failure modes, both live. (a) An implementer checks disk, sees the file, and closes #260 as already-done -- V2-005..V2-008 then build on an artifact that fails their own inputs. (b) An implementer regenerates the file from scratch and destroys committed work: section 3's retraction of the false 46/46 orphan figure, section 6's citation-defect record, and section 8's seven-item 'could NOT determine' list.
blockers.what_unblocks_it: Rule the existing file an INPUT rather than the deliverable, and restate V2-004 as 'extend the committed audit to a 46-row 7-column matrix' with an explicit instruction not to regenerate. Preserve sections 3, 6 and 8 verbatim.

blockers.title: V2-004 AC3 names a directory that does not contain the 46-policy corpus AC1 requires
blockers.what_is_missing: AC3 requires the header to attest that the read pass 'covered ~/.claude/policies/ line-by-line'. AC1 requires exactly 46 policy rows. MEASURED: ~/.claude/policies/ holds 44 .md files recursively across 5 subdirectories, of which 10 are README.md and 2 are non-policy summaries, leaving 32 policy documents. docs/policies/ holds 46 .md files flat. The two sets differ: 18 basenames in docs/policies/ are absent from ~/.claude/policies/, and 7 names exist live that are not in docs/policies/. The 46-policy corpus every count in the plan rests on is docs/policies/ and policy_enforcement_raw.json (MEASURED: 46 records), not the live tree AC3 names. A line-by-line read of ~/.claude/policies/ cannot produce 46 rows.
blockers.what_unblocks_it: Decide which tree is the corpus of record and rewrite AC3 to name it. If docs/policies/ is authoritative, AC3's '~/.claude/policies/' is simply the wrong path and all five D1 issues inherit the error.

blockers.title: Only 4 of batch A's 8 issues have an empty blocked_by; the sprint plan's batch table does not show this
blockers.what_is_missing: MEASURED from github_issues.json: V2-005 blocked_by ['V2-004']; V2-006 ['V2-005']; V2-007 ['V2-005']; V2-008 ['V2-006','V2-007']. The D1 set is a serial chain V2-004 -> V2-005 -> {V2-006, V2-007} -> V2-008, four levels deep, carrying 18 of batch A's 23 points. sprint_plan.md states 'Everything here has zero blocking dependency on any other batch. Batch A is the only batch that can start today.' That sentence is literally accurate about OTHER batches, but the batch A table lists 8 issues with no blocked_by column, so a reader staffing batch A in parallel will find 4 of 8 immediately blocked.
blockers.what_unblocks_it: Add a blocked_by column to the batch A table, or state the D1 chain depth explicitly. Staff batch A as 3 startable issues (5 points) plus one contested 8-point item, not 8 parallel issues.

blockers.what_unblocks_it: Add V2-017 to V2-026's and V2-027's blocked_by, and post the corresponding cross-reference comments on #282 and #283.

blockers.title: V2-008's '25 capabilities' disagrees with capability_loss.md's own enumeration of 27 table rows
blockers.what_is_missing: MEASURED: capability_loss.md contains 3 tables with 16 + 9 + 2 = 27 data rows. V2-008 AC1 and SRS NFR-10 say 25. docs/REVIEW-INDEX.md section 5 describes the same file as '14 PreToolUse gates, 9 PostToolUse capabilities' = 23. The 25 figure RECONCILES as 14 + 9 + 2 only if rows 15 and 16 of the PreToolUse table are excluded -- 'Warm-daemon fast path' and 'PolicyRegistry', the two mechanism rows, the latter explicitly tagged 'FR-9 (mechanism)'. That exclusion rule is stated nowhere in the AC. V2-008 AC2 mandates 'A script cross-checks the 25 names against the matrix and fails if any is missing' -- a script parsing the tables gets 27 and fails on two rows that were never meant to be in scope.
blockers.what_unblocks_it: State the exclusion rule in AC2, or change the count to 27 and give the 2 mechanism rows dispositions. Three different counts (23, 25, 27) for one file must collapse to one.

blockers.title: issue_key_map.json still carries V2-009 at the pre-correction size, so the two machine-readable sources disagree by 3 points
blockers.what_is_missing: MEASURED: issue_key_map.json holds V2-009 size=5, size_provenance='SOURCED'. github_issues.json holds size=8, size_provenance='RE_ESTIMATED'. Summing all 36 non-null sizes gives 108 in issue_key_map.json and 111 in github_issues.json. Comparing the two files key-by-key, V2-009 is the ONLY mismatch of 36 -- every other key agrees on both size and provenance. The RE_ESTIMATED provenance value does not exist anywhere in issue_key_map.json, so correcting the number alone would still leave 'SOURCED' wrong. The file was last written by commit 78fe384, which predates the re-point commit c4fd55d.

blockers.what_unblocks_it: Set V2-009 size=8 and provenance=RE_ESTIMATED in issue_key_map.json, and add RE_ESTIMATED to its provenance vocabulary.
